Author: dajoey
Name: Lazy Gear Collector
Description: Tracks upgradable gear collections piece by piece. Starts with Occult Crescent: North Horn's Phantom Vision sets - all 7 roles, 5 slots, 4 tiers. Shows which pieces you own and at what tier, what the next upgrade costs, and the exact obol/fixative shortfall to finish a role or the whole collection. Every item ID and price is read from the game's own shop data at runtime, so it stays correct across patches. Also flags Arcanaut's gear you can trade up for free. Use /lazygear to open.
Punchline: Track upgradable gear sets and what it costs to finish them
Changelog:
v0.0.2.5 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The window was polished for the real in-game font and scale: text no longer clips or sits against card borders.
- The window uses a branded top bar with Overview, Roles and Settings, a status pill and a close button, plus a page header and a two-line status footer.
- Overview shows progress cards, a role progress list and a requirements card beside the settings.
- Role pages list each piece with its owned state and the materials still needed, with long material names shown in full.
- Search results open in a floating list under the search box so the page does not shift while typing, and narrow windows collapse the page choices into a dropdown.

v0.0.2.4 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The collector window now presents role progress, material requirements, ownership and collection settings in a responsive card-based layout with custom navigation, a close button and search across roles and pages. Collection planning, ownership scanning, shop and trade-up logic, saved settings and hub quick controls are unchanged.

v0.0.2.3 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- The plugin windows have been rebuilt on the shared LalaUiKit: one consistent layout with themed section headers, unified spacing and colour accents. All settings and behaviour are unchanged, and existing configuration loads as-is.

v0.0.2.2 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.

v0.0.2.1 (2026-10-03) [testing]
- **Quick controls for the Lazy Hub window.** The plugin now offers whether the saddlebag and retainers count and the target tier to Lazy Hub (`/lazy`) over Dalamud IPC, so they can be changed from one window next to the other lalalazy plugins. Each change does exactly what the matching setting in the plugin's own window does.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.
- Without Lazy Hub installed the plugin behaves exactly as before.

v0.0.2.0 (2026-09-05)

- Added the in-game "What's new" popup. After Lazy Gear Collector updates, its changelog now opens once inside the game so the changes are visible without a trip to GitHub. It waits until the character is logged in and out of combat, duty, cutscenes and zoning; closing it (Got it, X or Escape) marks it read. Type `/lazygear changelog` any time to reopen it.
- No change to collection tracking: the Phantom Vision set, tier detection, ownership counting and the remaining-cost figures are all unchanged.
